module_purpose: Tool-call recovery for Ollama-style OpenAI responses.
responsibilities: Tool-call recovery for Ollama-style OpenAI responses.

public_api.name: test_textual_tool_calls_ignore_inline_python_when_tools_registered
public_api.description: Code lines like `print(x)` / `if b=0` must NOT become tool calls.

public_api.name: test_textual_tool_calls_accept_registered_tool_line
public_api.description: A line that really is a tool call is still recognized.

public_api.name: test_textual_tool_calls_reject_bullet_code_lines
public_api.description: Bullet-prefixed code noise from Ollama must not be promoted to tools.

public_api.name: test_extract_message_usage_reads_native_ollama_counters
public_api.description: Native Ollama exposes prompt_eval_count / eval_count at meta top level.

public_api.name: test_compact_conversation_shrinks_old_tool_results
public_api.description: Old big tool results get excerpted rather than kept whole.

public_api.name: test_extract_thought_segments_bracket_markers
public_api.description: Some finetunes emit [THINKING]…[/THINKING] instead of XML.

public_api.name: test_extract_reasoning_from_response_deepseek_reasoning_content
public_api.description: DeepSeek-R1 on OpenAI-compat: reasoning_content sits in additional_kwargs.

public_api.name: test_extract_reasoning_from_response_openrouter_reasoning_string
public_api.description: OpenRouter surfaces reasoning as a top-level string on the message.

public_api.name: test_extract_reasoning_from_response_openai_reasoning_summary_string
public_api.description: Some deployments flatten reasoning_summary to a plain string.

public_api.name: test_extract_reasoning_from_response_gemini_thought_flag
public_api.description: Gemini marks reasoning parts with {'thought': True, 'text': '...'}

public_api.name: test_extract_reasoning_from_response_cohere_tool_plan
public_api.description: Cohere Command emits tool_plan in additional_kwargs/response_metadata.

public_api.name: test_extract_reasoning_from_response_avoids_nontext_values
public_api.description: Boolean/numeric noise must not explode the parser.

public_api.name: test_build_aimessage_from_ollama_tool_parse_error_recovers_write_file
public_api.description: Ollama/Go rejects JSON where a string has `\` before a backtick (``` in markdown).

public_api.name: test_build_aimessage_from_ollama_tool_parse_error_recovers_run_command_equals_syntax
public_api.description: Models sometimes emit ``timeout_seconds=120`` instead of JSON ``"timeout_seconds": 120``.
